Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION[BetterTransit: Minimum width of the open vehicle list. 0 fits the list to its contents; raise it if long names or several stats leave the rows cramped.
Height of the open vehicle list before it scrolls. 0 uses the default.
Width of the favourites panel. 0 uses the default.
Height of the favourites panel before it scrolls. 0 uses the default.
The unit vehicle speeds are shown in. Follow game uses km/h with the metric unit system and mph with the imperial one.
How the vehicle lists are ordered.
Show passenger capacity. For a multiple-unit train this is the whole consist.
Show acceleration in m/s². Useful when comparing stock for lines with closely spaced stops.
Show the vehicle's motive power, such as Electricity or Diesel. Dual-mode stock lists both.
Show the number of passenger-carrying cars in the consist. Locomotives, bogies and other cars with no capacity are not counted. Single units show nothing.
Show the vehicle's length, taken from its own geometry.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[NoMatchFilters]: No vehicles match the current filters
BetterTransitSelector.UI[FavouritesEmpty: Favourite a vehicle, family or pack in the list to add it here
Editor.FIELD_TOOLTIP[BetterTransitSelect: Icon for the upload's folder in the picker (the heading that groups everything from one Paradox Mods upload). Set it on one pack in the upload. With a shared heading, offers this as its icon.
A pack this pack sits under. The parent's name heads the folder and its icon is the folder's. Ship the parent asset in every upload that uses it. Leave None to use Display name or the upload instead.

The heading this pack lists under in the picker, e.g. 'DB Regio BaWü Trains'. Every pack with the same display name, from any creator, shares one folder (case and spacing do not matter). On a parent pack this is the heading shown instead of the prefab name.
Only for a pack used as Parent: keep its folder separate from anyone who merely types the same display name. Off, the folder merges with packs of the same display name.
The pack this vehicle is a variant of. Its name heads the group and its UI Object icon is the group's picture. Optional: leave None for a vehicle that only carries countries.
Position under the pack, low first. Leave gaps (10, 20, 30) so a later variant can be slotted between existing ones.
Where this vehicle plausibly operates, up to five. Shown as flags in the picker and filterable by players.
A picture for this vehicle's row in the picker only. Leave empty to use the asset's normal thumbnail. The rest of the game is unaffected.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Fleet.Tooltip]: Vehicles on the line now, and how many the line wants for its interval and loop time. Set by the route, not by the vehicle model.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[PerDeparture.To: Passengers one vehicle can carry. A range when several models are selected, since the game picks one at random for each vehicle it sends.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[FleetCapacity.T: Passengers the whole fleet carries at once, at the average capacity of the selected models.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[LoadNow.Tooltip: Passengers aboard right now against the seats on the line's current vehicles. The same figure as the transport overview's usage.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[LoadProjected.T: Today's riders spread over the fleet the line wants, if every vehicle were the selected models' average. Over 80% the line is crowded: pick bigger stock or raise the vehicle count to the number shown.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Scope.L: The line's selected models, the cars they are built from, and the cars already in this train.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Scope.A: Every car that can run on this track.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Empty]: Drag cars onto the track, click them in the list below, or start from a model or a running train.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.InsertH: New cars go into the highlighted coupling. Click it again to add to the end instead.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Stat.De: Go back to the car's own value
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Fit.Too: Fit the whole train in view
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Run.Too: Raise the pantographs, as on a running train
Drag to slide · right-drag to turn · wheel to zoom · double-click to reset
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Flip.To: Turn round: the selected cars swap order and face the other way.
Add another copy of the selected cars straight after them.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.SelectH: Click a car to select it, shift-click to select several, drag to move. Click a coupling to choose where new cars go.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.StartFr: Replace the train with what the game builds from one of the line's selected models.
Copy the engines at the front to the back of the train, turned round.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.NeedsPr: The line has not selected any lead car in this train, so the game would retire it.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.NeedsSe: None of this train's engines is a selected engine model, so the game would retire it.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.OtherMo: The line also has lead models selected that aren't in this train. Trains of those models already parked in the depot are sent out unchanged; deselect them to always get this train.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.NoLead]: Add a carriage or multiple-unit car: the train needs one to lead it.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.NoEngin: The line has an engine model selected; add an engine to this train.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Refitti: Refitting: {COUNT} train(s) still to replace, one at a time.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Mismatc: {COUNT} running train(s) still have the old cars. New trains are built like this.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.AllMatc: Every running train matches this train.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.Refit.T: Retire the old trains one at a time: each finishes at a stop and returns to its depot, and the depot sends a new one built like this. The line is never more than one train short.
BetterTransitSelector.UI[Consist.RefitSt: Stop replacing trains. A train already leaving the line still leaves.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION[BetterTransit: Show an info button on pack headers that opens the upload's page: description, subscribers, likes, links and screenshots from the game's mod browser data.
Show an info button on vehicle rows that opens the vehicle's page: big thumbnail, description, every stat, the consist car by car and the asset file.

Copies every pack you made in the editor (the .Prefab and its .cid) into ModsData/BetterTransitSelector/SharedPrefabs, ready to send to another creator. Packs received from others go into the same folder and the editor picks them up.
Opens the SharedPrefabs folder in your file browser.
